steps.name: Discharge by instrument
steps.obligation: {item} is discharged by the oracle class it named, with an evidence pointer

report_back.proof: the verdict row bound to {item} and its content hash
report_back.how: confirm the instrument ran and the evidence pointer resolves

steps.name: Hold the freeze witness
steps.obligation: {item} is proven against the same content hash it was synthesized from

report_back.proof: the content hash on the verdict row for {item}
report_back.where: the record, verdict row binds for {item}
report_back.how: recompute the artifact hash and confirm it matches the frozen witness
